integration_note: This file describes the unchanged default isolated preparation API. The separate integrated body analyzer opts into resumable expression requests using Checker.requests/requested/requested_expected; construct Checker through expressions.checker so those internal fields are initialized.
implemented: call-independent bidirectional expression typing with caller-supplied concrete bindings
literal bounds and canonical decimal spelling, including INT64_MIN
contextual lists, dictionaries, tuples and optional expected types
scalar, collection, numerical array, optional and comparison operator rules
tuple literal indexing, collection/array indexing and slices
record/error fields and conservative identifier suggestions
return-type joins for already-typed return sites
eager literal-default type checking for unspecialized file-scope functions and non-generic methods of non-generic records
structural exit masks, unreachable statements, loop-control context, explicit return completeness
structural closure traversal with independent loop and expression contexts
invalid_type_application: E3024; a standalone TypeApply is invalid in production too

apis.expressions.checker: owned syntax/pool, concrete name types, resolved declarations, source identity, visit limit, optional nominal generic parameter context -> Checker
apis.Checker.expression: syntax expression ID, expected semantic type ID=0 -> actual semantic type ID; contextual hint is not a final assignability check
apis.Checker.require: actual type, expected type, token; exact production mismatch diagnostic
apis.Checker.types: one semantic type ID per syntax expression; 0 means unvisited/unknown
apis.Checker.symbols: special INT64_MIN marker or tuple/field ordinal; not local variable symbol resolution
apis.return_types.infer: pool, already-typed Site(type,token) list, function token, source identity -> Result(pool,type,diagnostic); does not type conditions or resolve calls
apis.control_flow.check: parser-owned tree, source identity, visit limit, optional inferred-return kind overrides -> Result(statement masks, functions, script exits, visits, diagnostic)
apis.semantic_preparation.check: resolved signatures.Result, visit_limit=1048576 -> owned prepared Result; default checking then structural flow
apis.preparation_frontend.load: signature frontend followed by semantic preparation
apis.semantic_queries.inspect: test/benchmark fixture adapter; not a general compiler validation API

flow.loop: Next | (body & Returned); deliberately matches existing conservative production rules
flow.deferred_returns: Unknown return types retain return_check_deferred=true until real body inference
flow.generic_bodies: deferred until instantiation; generic record methods are not eagerly checked
flow.closures: structural checking only; no capture/type-safety guarantee

limits.visit_accounting: default expressions share one budget across modules; flow has one budget per module; these are algorithm limits, not OS heap/stack quotas

bootstrap_only_diagnostics.B3301: invalid semantic visit budget or test query mode
bootstrap_only_diagnostics.B3303: operation needs an unported body/call/specialization stage or unresolved binding

ownership.input: parser/loader/binder-produced acyclic arena graph and valid pool IDs; preserve their invariants
ownership.result: owned values and snapshot semantics; syntax and semantic IDs are separate
ownership.normalization: integer spellings, contextual literal kind/text and typed facts in an owned output snapshot; coordinates preserved
ownership.failure: preparation exports empty graph/facts/defaults/flows with located diagnostic
ownership.low_level_errors: Checker.fail records problem and raises; pool exhaustion can propagate R4010 from low-level primitives; preparation translates it to B3202
ownership.record_context: simple field substitution requires explicit nominal generic parameter names; does not instantiate records or establish layouts

wire.nested_signatures: existing format-1 signature reply is embedded unchanged
wire.identities: module/declaration/parameter indices refer to the owned preparation result; statement and expression positions use module-local syntax arenas; no stable cross-build symbol ABI
wire.encoding: JSON Lines; raw text/messages are lowercase hex bytes; exact byte coordinates
wire.priority: isolated prepass errors are not a promise of complete production first-error ordering
